SEGMENT.INSERT.summary: Writes entries to a segment of a volume at the given positions.
SEGMENT.INSERT.complexity: O(N) where N is the number of entries.

arguments.name: segment-id
arguments.summary: The id of the segment to write to.

arguments.name: entry
arguments.summary: One or more entries to write.

arguments.name: position
arguments.summary: Byte offset of the entry in the segment.
